✦ Welcome to Kizuna RNG! ✦
Roll anime characters, collect rare pulls, unlock their voices, and build bonds with your favorites!
❗THIS GAME DOES NOT CONTAIN ANY ROMANTIC TONES❗

🎲 ROLL – 25+ characters, from common to 1 in 3,000,000
✨ OPENINGS – Legendary & Mythic pulls get their own cinematic reveal
🌈 MUTATIONS – Hunt Golden, Rainbow & Corrupted versions
🔊 VOICES – Unlock voice lines for your favorite characters
💞 BONDS – Hugs, head pats & more raise affection and unlock signature moves
🍀 LUCK – Potions, biomes, lucky rolls & +10% luck for every friend in your server
📦 WEEKLY PACK – A new featured pack every week
📅 DAILY STREAK – Log in 7 days in a row for a free Epic+ character
🔨 CRAFT – Turn duplicates into rarer characters

🎁 CODES
RNG – 3 Heavenly Potions + 2,000 coins
ESDEATH – 5,000 coins + 3 Lucky Potions

👥 Join the group for 1,500 coins + 5 free rerolls!
👍 Like & favorite for new codes and updates!
